transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining. I wanted to get us together to talk through the press release package for the surprise partner-studio premiere we're planning to issue next week. The current draft is in decent shape — it names the film, includes a production still, shows our presenting-sponsor lockup, and links to a short promotional video. Before I approve anything, though, I want to make sure we've completed the standard final review across legal, publicity, partnerships, and accessibility. Has each of those teams had a chance to weigh in yet?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag something on the legal side. I confirmed with the partner studio's counsel this morning that the studio has approved the exact public title 'The Glass Orchard' and the exact identification line 'A new feature by Rowan Bell' — but only for a release issued after the studio's announcement window opens. Importantly, the package has not yet been updated with that written approval. So from a legal standpoint, we still need to get the package updated to reflect the studio's written sign-off before we can consider legal review complete.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: On the publicity side, I need to flag an issue with the image assets. I reviewed the studio's image-rights delivery sheet today, and the draft production still currently in the package is not cleared for festival publicity use. The only approved image is the file named 'GlassOrchard_KeyArt_Final.jpg,' which must replace the draft still before we can consider publicity review complete.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: On the partnerships side, I need to flag a critical issue. I confirmed with the presenting sponsor this afternoon that its contract actually bars the sponsor logo and any co-branding from appearing beside this partner-studio announcement. The sponsor must be acknowledged in text on the festival website, but the sponsor lockup has to be omitted from the release artwork and social card. So the current draft, which displays the presenting-sponsor lockup, is not compliant and needs to be updated before partnerships review can be considered complete.
